Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

Validation: which checks ran, and any remaining limitations.

If tests changed, name the behavior or plausible failure they protect. No coverage targets or tests for routine framework behavior.

For UI changes, link the design and independent review, and include the actual interface inspection result.

For analyzer suppressions or new dependencies, explain the need, scope, and maintenance cost. Do not add a broad suppression or baseline to make CI pass.

Sign off each commit (`git commit -s`). Do not include journal content, setup or recovery codes, recovery keys, connection files or tokens in the description, logs or screenshots.
